summary: Backend: 9/9 pytest passing (root, settings default+patch+custom map, subscription default, activate trial/monthly/quarterly with correct day deltas, invalid plan→400, cancel, sessions create+list; no _id leaks). Frontend: app loads on mobile viewport, header/speed display/START button/mode pills/sim-speed/window-section/upgrade-cta/free-note all render. START toggles Auto Volume ON, speed animates from 0→12, volume bar fills (22%), STOP resets. Paywall opens, plan-trial selectable, activate-btn calls API and dismisses. Settings opens, sensitivity/smoothing segments tappable, cancel-pro-btn shown (confirms backend tier=pro). BUG: tier-pill on main screen stays FREE and pro-status card never appears after paywall activation because index.tsx fetches subscription only once in useEffect([]) and never refetches when the paywall closes via router.back().

ui_bugs.issue: After activating Pro on /paywall, returning to main screen still shows tier-pill='FREE' and upgrade-cta instead of pro-status card. Subscription is fetched only on mount and never refreshed on focus.

integration_issues.issue: Main screen does not refetch /api/subscription/{user_id} when paywall dismisses; backend correctly sets tier=pro (verified: settings screen shows cancel-pro-btn) but main screen UI is stale.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings in expo logs: 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props deprecated; should migrate to boxShadow/textShadow shorthand. Non-blocking.

action_items: Fix index.tsx (and optionally settings.tsx) to refetch subscription/settings on screen focus. Use useFocusEffect from expo-router or @react-navigation/native so that returning from /paywall or /settings reflects updated tier and Pro features. Same applies to settings screen reading sub after returning.
Optional: also re-pull settings on focus to reflect changes made on /settings screen.
Consider migrating deprecated shadow*/textShadow* style props to boxShadow/textShadow.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts cancelPro sends plan='monthly' in body though backend ignores it; harmless but misleading.

index.tsx and settings.tsx both fetch subscription independently with no shared store → state drift between screens (root cause of tier-pill bug). A small zustand/context store or useFocusEffect refresh would resolve it.
server.py activate endpoint accepts plan via ActivatePro model but cancel reuses the same model requiring 'plan' field; consider a separate CancelPro model with only user_id.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral users prefixed TEST_ in mongo; no cleanup performed but isolated per UUID.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid. After E1 fixes the focus-refresh bug in index.tsx, retest: activate trial in paywall → confirm tier-pill becomes 'PRO' and pro-status card appears on main screen without app reload. Also verify cancel-pro-btn flow flips tier-pill back to FREE on main after returning from settings.
rca_of_issue: index.tsx line ~89-97: const [sub, setSub] = useState; useEffect(() => { fetchSubscription(id) }, []) runs only on mount. When user navigates to /paywall, activates Pro, and router.back() returns to /index, the component is still mounted so the effect doesn't rerun → sub state remains the pre-activation value. Fix: wrap subscription/settings fetch in useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => { ... }, [userId])) from expo-router.
